summary.text: Angela Nelson is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 35 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Jim Abeler.
An elementary school principal, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is a lifelong Coon Rapids resident.

paragraphs.text: Nelson graduated from Coon Rapids High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota, Duluth, in 2000, and holds a graduate degree from Hamline University.
In the survey, she said she is the mother of two teenagers and has spent her career in public education.

Nelson listed lowering costs for families, affordable and accessible health care, and a healthy environment as her main campaign messages, including free public preschool for four-year-olds and broader MinnesotaCare coverage options.
Her Democratic primary was canceled, and she advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
